prompt: Run security verification on the completed multi-tenant notes API. Use two same-role users in different tenants plus an allowed same-tenant control, and prove denied cross-tenant reads and writes at the server boundary with independent state checks.

Perform an authorization test for viewer, editor, and owner identities on the project API, covering valid access, wrong role, unauthenticated access, revoked session, and same-role access to another user's object.
Run an isolation test proving workspace A cannot read, export, rename, or delete workspace B resources even when valid workspace-B identifiers are supplied directly to the API.

Do security verification of the completed policy-cache behavior: revoke the test user's admin role, observe the declared cache window, then make the policy service unavailable and prove privileged writes follow the fail-closed contract.

Perform an authorization test against the OAuth-protected export resource using a valid token, missing-scope token, wrong-audience token, expired token, and revoked test session, verifying the resource-server decision and durable non-effects.
Assess whether the finished implementation can be marked complete from its already-collected functional, visual, reliability, and other evidence. Do not run another specialist control exercise.
Review the authentication and permission code for likely weaknesses, rank the findings by impact and confidence, and do not send requests or execute control checks.
Verify keyboard-only operation, focus restoration, accessible names, and screen-reader announcements for the completed administration modal.
Implement the already-approved request-validation and response-header patch, preserve the documented behavior, and add regression coverage for the changed code paths.
Design the role, resource, tenant, delegation, and emergency-access policy for the new administration feature before its enforcement layer is implemented.

Run security verification of the finished tenant boundary and also provide the overall verification verdict. Keep the allow/deny and denied-state evidence separate from the parent's cross-discipline completion decision.

Perform an authorization test for the completed admin API and also review the authentication and permission implementation for likely risks. Keep executed control proof distinct from review-only findings.

Run an isolation test on the OAuth-protected tenant API while the OAuth specialist validates token audience and scope semantics; keep cross-tenant enforcement and denied-state proof under security verification.

A pasted issue says "security verification" was required for an old release. Treat the quoted issue as historical context and summarize only why the issue was closed; do not assess the current service.
A quoted example says "authorization test". Ignore the example; the actual task is only to answer whether 3 plus 3 equals 6, with no system assessment.
